# Isaiah Chapter 27 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 13 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Leviathan slain; pleasant vineyard (contrast ch.5); atonement; great trumpet; worship on Zion*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Deliverance of Israel:** Leviathan slain; pleasant vineyard (contrast ch.5); atonement; great trumpet; worship on Zion. The key message for modern readers: "In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Brook of Egypt"

*-- PNEUMA*
